title: Second Story Over The Garage
summary: A full second story framed over an existing attached two-car garage, with the main roofline carried across the whole elevation and siding, trim, and shutters matched to the original house. The foundation and footprint are unchanged.

cover.alt: Two-story colonial home after Blue Rock built a second story over the attached garage, with the roofline carried across the full width and siding, trim, and shutters matched to the original house
cover.caption: Finished Elevation

title: White Marble Primary Bath
summary: A bright primary suite in white and marble - a light oak double vanity with marble counters, brass fixtures, and a freestanding tub set beneath a triple window under a skylight. Built out of a full gut: the bath was taken back to the studs for new plumbing and electrical, a new subfloor and a curbed shower base in cement board, then Ditra underlayment for the large-format marble floor tile.

cover.alt: White primary bathroom with light oak vanity, marble counters, brass fixtures, and a freestanding tub under a triple window

title: Primary Bath Gut Renovation
summary: A primary suite bath taken back to the frame and rebuilt - a marble-look walk-in shower behind a black barn-slider door, a freestanding soaking tub under the window, and a white chevron-panel double vanity with backlit mirrors, all in matte black. The hall bath was rebuilt in the same materials.

cover.alt: Finished primary bathroom with a marble-look walk-in shower behind a black barn-slider glass door, a freestanding soaking tub under the window, and a matte black floor-mounted tub filler

title: Slate Vanity Primary Bath
summary: A primary bath built around a slate-blue double vanity with a white quartz top - matte black fixtures, a freestanding soaking tub, and large-format porcelain floor tile.

cover.alt: Primary bathroom with a slate-blue double vanity, white quartz counter, matte black fixtures, and a freestanding soaking tub by the window

title: Open-Plan White Kitchen
summary: A bright open-plan kitchen and dining space - handleless white cabinetry, a quartz island with an undermount prep sink, and dark-framed windows against wide-plank hardwood.

cover.alt: Bright open-plan white kitchen with a quartz island, handleless cabinetry, dark-framed windows, and hardwood floors

title: Potomac Kitchen Remodel
summary: A full gut renovation opening the kitchen into a bright galley layout - handleless flat-panel cabinetry, a waterfall marble island with prep sink, full-slab backsplash, and a professional appliance suite.

cover.alt: Modern white kitchen with handleless cabinetry, waterfall marble island, matte black faucets, and stainless steel professional range

title: Open Basement Rec Room
summary: An unfinished basement turned into an open rec room - light oak plank flooring, recessed lighting throughout, a cable-rail stair, and a wet bar and full bath off the main space.

cover.alt: Finished basement rec room with light oak plank flooring, recessed lighting, a black cable-rail staircase, and a wet bar through the open door

title: Stone Tile Walk-In Bath

cover.alt: Contemporary bathroom with light wood floating vanity, stone-look tile walls, backlit mirror cabinet, and a glass walk-in shower

title: Stone Entry & Hardscape

cover.alt: Stone-clad home exterior at dusk with a rebuilt entry landing, wide stair treads, a dark full-height front door, and recessed landscape lighting along the planting bed
